name: Isosurface Simplification via Persistence
definition: A simplification technique for topological objects modeled as meshes, used for noise removal and feature selection in volume visualization. It addresses the problem of identifying and removing insignificant topological features based on their persistence.
summary: Isosurface Simplification via Persistence removes insignificant topological features from meshes by prioritizing geometric metrics and isovalue range persistence over raw histogram analysis.
